messages:
maria: Heads-up: rolling out 'route-weighted-shift' config to gradually steer overflow to reserve pools. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% -> 40%. Need quick ops + telemetry + console check.

devin: re: fallback behavior  if reserve pools are saturated, do we circuit-break back to original routing or queue?

maria: circuit-breakback to original routing after 200ms queue window. that's in the snapshot as `overflow_policy: circuit_break`.

anya: telemetry checklist: `reserve_pool_util`, `route_shift_ratio`, `queued_requests_pct`, `tenant_error_rate`. add an alert: queued_requests_pct > 1.5% for 3m triggers auto-pause.

leo: console changes: show snapshot id, active cohort %, and a small history link that opens last 3 snapshots diff. add a strong rollback button that calls POST /internal/snapshots/{id}/pause. UI will debounce clicks.

ops-bot: Canary job queued: `route-weighted-shift-1789998888` scheduled at 2026-05-10T14:00:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/1789998888

maria: preflight smoke passed. launching 2% now. ping if graphs spike.

devin: seeing traces with header X-Route-Snapshot and expected tag. no errors yet.

anya: dashboards live. slight p95 bump but p99 steady. holding to promote.

maria: promoting to 10% in 20m if green. thanks all.
